name: xk-transfer-pricing
description: Prepare Kosovo transfer-pricing workpapers for 2026 corporate controlled transactions using the current corporate statute, the complete transfer-pricing instruction and tax-authority filing guidance. Covers related parties, specified jurisdictions, comparability, tested parties, pricing methods, ranges and adjustments, group-service benefit tests, the simplified low-value markup, documentation contents, annual transaction notification, loan balances, response deadlines and current procedural sanctions. Distinguishes the statute's universal documentation duty from the notification threshold and records conflicts in older guidance and translations. Use for intercompany goods, financing, guarantees, services, intangibles, capital transfers, local files, master files and corresponding-adjustment requests. Individual-business pricing and wider multinational reporting require their own applicable rules.
